value.signature: fn fragment_datasets (root : & Path , families : & [& str]) -> Result < BTreeMap < String , envelope :: Dataset > >

review.body: { if families . is_empty () { return Ok (BTreeMap :: new ()) ; } let output = std :: process :: Command :: new ("python3") . arg ("-B") . arg (root . join ("ci/registry_fragments.py")) . arg (root) . args (families) . output () ? ; if ! output . status . success () { return Err (format ! ("fragment loader: {}" , String :: from_utf8_lossy (& output . stderr)) . into ()) ; } let text = std :: str :: from_utf8 (& output . stdout) ? ; let values : Vec < _ > = text . lines () . collect () ; if values . len () != families . len () { return Err ("fragment loader returned a different envelope count" . into ()) ; } families . iter () . zip (values) . map (| (family , value) | Ok (((* family) . to_owned () , envelope :: json (value) ?))) . collect () }
review.item_premise: Only named public registry families and their complete public dataset envelopes cross this validating loader boundary. It batches process startup without altering family validation, envelope order or projection; failed loading publishes no partial dataset.
